g.text: Objective: start the build on a safe output folder and keep only the sidecars the viewer can read and render.

text.tspan: reports/*/analysis/*.json
the sidecars of the checked-out commit
the base address of the site is normalised
one leading and one trailing slash
the output folder is refused
the build stops with an error
the output folder is ready
the .bot-site marker file is in it
the sidecar is skipped
a skip leaves a warning in the log
the sidecar is read
the sidecars are grouped by ticker, newest analysis first
the analysis has every field
an analysis the views cannot read is skipped with a warning;
a company with no analysis left is dropped
Comes out:
each company the viewer can render, its analyses newest first, each one complete

g.text: the build normalises the base address of the site

text.tspan: the build refuses the output folder [it holds the reports, or it is not empty and not a site output]
refused when it is or holds the reports folder, it exists and is not a folder, or it is not empty and has no .bot-site marker file
the build empties the output folder and marks it as its own [the folder is safe]
the folder is emptied, or created when missing, and the .bot-site marker is written before any page
the scan skips the sidecar [the folder name is not a date]
the folder name must be a YYYY-MM-DD date, read back unchanged
the scan skips the sidecar [the sidecar name is not a ticker]
the ticker is up to twelve characters among capital letters, digits, . and -

g.text: the scan skips the sidecar [it cannot be read as a JSON object]

text.tspan: the scan skips the sidecar [the schema version is not supported]
schema_version must be 1
the scan skips the sidecar [the ticker inside differs from the sidecar name]
analysis.ticker must equal the file name
the scan reads the sidecar
[it passes every check above]

g.text: the build skips the sidecar [an analysis field is missing]

text.tspan: the build reads the verdict from the sidecar [margin of safety (MoS) 1.3 or more]
MoS = intrinsic value ÷ price

g.text: the build reads the verdict from the sidecar [margin of safety (MoS) from 1.0 to under 1.3]
the build reads the verdict from the sidecar [margin of safety (MoS) below 1.0]
the build reads the verdict from the sidecar [no price]

text.tspan: the viewer renders the company
[the analysis is kept]
